reading_note: A litany tracing every spiritual gift back to its origin in a specific degree of the divine emanation. The arc descends from the Father of Lights (the Lord as source of all good) through the Mother of Life (the matrix of spiritual life from which truth is born), the Beloved (celestial good of love), the First Man (divine truth sent into the natural for combat), the Living Spirit / Great Builder (operative power that constructs the spiritual mind), the Releaser (truth that frees the bound by the Word), the Virgin of Light (purity of reception), and culminates in the Mind of Light — the awakener who raises sleeping souls and gathers the scattered, returning all lights and lives to eternal inheritance. Each "Origin" pairs a class of spiritual function with the specific divine quality from which it flows.
